title: Undo my last turn is back in single player
description: Single-player (offline) games, real engine games with a fixed seed. The event log has the turn undo again: Go back over (the last turn or the last two turns) and an Undo my last turn button. It takes the game back to the start of your last turn(s), the bots decide again from the same game, and the turn you took back can be redone with the log's Redo. There is no seat picker, no replay strip and no saved original (those belong to the multiplayer redo). npm run screenshots -- EW asserts: the button is shown with that label, one click saves fewer answers, the turn menu is asked again, a reload resumes at the undone position and the game plays on.
